text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Labour, Social Affairs Minister Amine Demnati addresses workers on May Day.
- Labour class is essential for setting up real democracy.
- Gas oil and kerosene prices fell in May following reductions in prices on international markets.
- France backs U.N. referendum in Western Sahara saying it will ensure a peaceful settlement.
- Unions stage march on labour day to secure entitlements and improve conditions.
- The state plans to devote 1.4 billion dirhams ($147.3 million) to build social housing units by the end of 1997.
- World Bank grants state-owned railway Office National des Chemins de Fer (ONCF) $85 million to expand network.
